taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Agent prepared browser actions bound to current frame, form and account
controls.source_trace: Follow page-provided instructions or identifiers into navigation and externally visible actions. Distinguish reading page data from authority to submit, purchase or message.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate trusted user requests from page text, advertisements, downloaded documents and tool output. Confirm site/account and the material action at the commit step, including navigation between preparation and submission. Viewing or drafting an action is not a financial or messaging effect; test commits only in an owned simulation with explicit synthetic recipients.
controls.operational_method: Bind the prepared action to browsing context, frame origin, account, destination and material form fields at commit. Retain a DOM/target generation or revalidate after page navigation and form mutation; a stale selector can submit to a different destination while its label stays unchanged. Compare an owned checkout/message simulator before and after a target/frame/account change, without making a real purchase or sending a message.
controls.controlled_verification: Prepare an action in an owned browser simulator, then change its frame/account/form destination or DOM target before commit. Compare unchanged authorized commit with revalidated/blocked changed context; use synthetic recipients and values only.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Merely displaying hostile text is not task deviation; require an actual unauthorized tool action or committed fixture effect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind browser actions to user/site/account intent and verify normal task completion plus ignored page-originated authority claims.
